annotation.title_clean: Robot telepresence as a practical tool for responsible and open research in trustworthy autonomous systems
annotation.title_en: Robot telepresence as a practical tool for responsible and open research in trustworthy autonomous systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Waterstone, R; Robillard, JM; Prescott, TJ
annotation.summary_en: Journal article proposing an Open Laboratories approach complementing Responsible Research and Innovation and Open Science for Trustworthy Autonomous Systems. It argues robot telepresence enables scalable, safe, inclusive first-person access to labs, building experience-based public trust while reducing environmental and infection concerns.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public trust in autonomous systems is hindered by cloistered research and poor communication.
Open Laboratories complement RRI and Open Science by making research processes visible.
Robot telepresence gives authentic, first-person lab access that is scalable and safe.
Telepresence improves inclusion and diversity and cuts travel-related environmental impacts.
Direct contact with robots facilitates attitude change and technical literacy.
